outcome: Effective dose in 50% of subjects (ED50) of butorphanol for preventing pruritus
cohort: 120 parturients receiving epidural morphine for post-cesarean analgesia
finding: Prophylactic use of palonosetron reduced the ED50 of prophylactic butorphanol infusion by 8% for achieving satisfactory antipruritic effect after epidural morphine for post-cesarean analgesia.
